ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (~75%) with high-contrast black pixel clusters (~25%) distributed across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark blobs and circular spots (mottling) scattered across both lobes; highest density clusters are located in the mid-lower section of the left lobe and along the inner margins leading to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex angle; deep depression relative to the horizontal plane of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with sharp peak-to-valley transitions across the entire continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, sweeping symmetrically outward and upward into a vertical orientation at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity (black) pixel clusters on the white background, localized primarily on the proximal and mid-regions of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark curved linear disruption is visible on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe, cutting across the pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular brownish-red clusters of macro-organism growth (likely barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water spray and high-intensity droplets shedding from the trailing edges and barnacle clusters.
